File infra/environments/<env>.egress.json, GENERATED by INF-002-S03 from `terraform output` of stack 20-network (never hand-edited) and mirrored to SSM /bridge/<env>/egress/ips (JSON of this document). CON-102-S01 serves it as GET /v1/platform/egress-ips (customer-facing API, RECONCILIATION U-24); the install script and wizard render the customer network-policy snippet from `allowlist` (docs/runbooks/customer-network-policy.md). Change rule: an IP set is announced ≥ 90 days before it becomes the egress set, and a replaced set stays in the allowlist until retire_after (RECONCILIATION C-13). Invariants checked by tools/network/validate_egress.py: allowlist = ips ∪ previous_ips ∪ announced_ips (sorted, unique); announced_effective_from ≥ published_at + notice_days; retire_after ≥ effective_from + notice_days when previous_ips is non-empty; ips equals `aws ec2 describe-addresses` for EIPs tagged bridge:egress-published=true; SELECT CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS() from a WIF session ∈ ips (INF-002-S11 oracle).
title: Egress IP publication

published_at.description: UTC instant this revision of the file was generated.

generated_by.description: Pipeline run that generated the file (workflow run URL or ID).

ips.description: ACTIVE egress IPs: the NAT Elastic IPs all extractor/verifier traffic uses now (one per NAT gateway; no IPv6 egress path).

effective_from.description: When `ips` became the active egress set.

previous_ips.description: Former egress IPs no longer used but still to be allowlisted by customers until retire_after.

retire_after.description: Instant after which previous_ips may be removed from customer allowlists; null when previous_ips is empty.

announced_ips.description: IPs that will become the egress set at announced_effective_from; customers must add them now.

allowlist.description: Everything a customer network policy must allow today: ips ∪ previous_ips ∪ announced_ips.

eip_allocation_ids.description: EIP allocation IDs behind `ips` (also written back to config egress.eip_allocation_ids).
